sections.name: architecture
sections.value: Doctrine: .agents-skills-port/pij-team/TENETS.md. Rust. u1 lives in crates/cli/src/main.rs and crates/cli/src/identity.rs: every acting-seat verb sends all available identity inputs to POST /v1/whoami; the daemon's one authority treats an observable pane as authoritative, accepts PIJ_SESSION_ID only when no pane contradicts it, refuses disagreement by name, and names `env -u PIJ_SESSION_ID` as recovery. Send flags: optional --from/--msg-id, --body or --body-file path/stdin; Telegram sidecar also derives optional --from and mints optional --msg-id because its sender binds inbound reply routing. Do NOT re-implement the daemon ladder. u2: crates/daemon/src/pointer/mod.rs says `pij inbox check`; pane-bound adopt responses explain pane identity, while successful paneless register responses emit the export required by later commands. Ruling: weasel 2026-09-02 — every pane-bound harness, including omp/pi, gets pane-derived identity guidance; export advice is paneless-only.

value.rationale: One crate, one module, two text edits. PM codes, proves live, Claude opus reviewer.

value.name: cli identity + body sources
value.responsibility: Derived acting seats for send/report/inbox and Telegram sidecar; optional send/Telegram identity and msg-id; body arg/file/stdin; named recoverable refusals.
value.interface: resolve_acting_seat(env, pane, client) -> Result<SeatId, NamedRefusal>; send flags: --to (req), --body|--body-file (one req), --from (opt, must agree), --msg-id (opt); Telegram --from/--msg-id optional and derived/minted
value.test_strategy: RED-first unit + fake-daemon integration for contradictions, recovery, and AC3; live AC1/AC2/AC4.
value.note: Do not change the wire; existing HTTP requests still receive concrete from+msg_id values filled by the CLI.

value.name: notice texts
value.responsibility: Pointer says pij inbox check; pane-bound adopt gets pane-derived identity guidance; paneless register gets export advice.
value.test_strategy: exact render/adopt/register tests; cover claude/copilot/codex/omp/pi pane-bound cases and paneless registration.
value.note: Rebased after plan 128; preserve harness-session registration while changing response metadata only.

Default: each coder gets its own worktree, branching off the PM's plan branch; unit lands back onto the plan branch (PM merges — coders never merge). Shared-tree work is the retro-proven #1 hazard (staged sweeps, untrustworthy greens) — only choose it for trivially disjoint single-wave work, and then file-scoped `git add` only, never -A. REMEMBER: fences partition WRITE intent, not the build — a mid-refactor sibling can still break your compile, so waves must respect build dependencies, and a broken workspace build is a PM composition concern, not a coder's to fix cross-fence.

value.steps: Rebase onto origin/main after plan 128 merges (ask prime); build; cargo test; clippy; harness checks (symlink canonical node_modules); live AC1/AC2/AC4 against an ISOLATED daemon (never restart production) with hand-started omp + claude panes pointed at it via PIJ_RS_ADDR/PIJ_RS_STATE_DIR.

value.when: after composition (or after solo-pm coding), before the PR into main
value.inputs: plan.dd.md + this impl-guide + full branch diff; priority = plan promises, composition seams, interface drift, correctness, contract-test gaps

value.text: A --from that agrees with the pane is fine; the refusal must fire only on DISAGREEMENT (test both).
stdin body read must not hang when no stdin is attached: only read when --body-file - is explicit.
